source.text: 雷澤中有雷神，龍身而人頭，鼓其腹。在吳西。

inferences.basis: 选定正文明确龍身而人頭。细长龙躯、完整人颅、接颈、鳞片、腹部体积、长短比例与尖尾均属结构设计补足。
正文未列手臂、腿爪、角翼或尾的数量。无臂、无足、无角与无翼是本设计的选择；后世雷公的双臂、鸟翼、鸟喙或法器形象不属于本条明文。
鼓其腹是原文，但没有明确手臂或实施方式。本作以腹段两次缓慢抬动演绎，并以原地三维行波表现游弋；节律起伏不是唯一或确定释义。正文没有外置鼓、鼓槌、则雷结果句、春雷季节或固定节奏。
正文未记人首龙身颜色、发式、紫电金光、云气或鸣声。苍青鳞片、浅灰腹鳞、暖肤和短黑发均属于艺术设色；吴西保留为古文方位。

anatomy: Native complete healthy human head, intact eyes/ears/closed lips/chin/hair/posterior cranium, continuous upright scaled neck into extended long body and one tapering pointed tail. No arms/feet/horns/wings is an artistic selection, not an explicit classical count.
maskSemantics: Independent native geometry half-planes/seeds before weights. Complete head13662; neck12883; body37321 includes every non-head point including neck and tail; tail4360. Runtime matches bidirectional native world rest positions, never raw source indices into reordered compressed arrays or weight-derived masks.

runtimeContract.sourceFaceForward: Blender +X / glTF +X; body long axis Blender Y / glTF -Z; native relative orientation retained
runtimeContract.permanentElevationMethod: Baked translation in native mesh coordinates and matching skeleton rests; no normalization node scale
runtimeContract.animatedRootTranslation: Small periodic vertical bob centered at zero; no X/Z runtime locomotion
runtimeContract.specialReturn: Matches idle phase0 pose, velocity and acceleration at both endpoints
runtimeContract.interpolation: 60fps source keys; actual periodic C2 glTF CUBICSPLINE; Float32 residuals disclosed in QA
runtimeContract.boneScale: Every bone scale is exactly one in all clips; no longitudinal stretching

nativeAttributePassthrough.geometryChange: Positive uniform source normalization and permanent translation only

nativeRestQA.degenerateDisclosure: All stored native zero/nearly-zero facets are retained exactly; the evaluated rest count can cross the1e-14m2 threshold due to Float32 inverse-bind roundoff. No geometric or manifold repair.

tolerances.rawNormalUVIndexBytes: exact SHA256 and index equality; no codec tolerance required
tolerances.reason: Rest positions use float32 normalization and float32 inverse-bind matrices. Source NORMAL/UV/index payload passes through unchanged; Blender decoded corner-normal codec is bypassed in actual GLB

weightCorrection.reason: Nearest3D centerline branch switching at axial07/08 caused walk local edge strain8.52%.
weightCorrection.method: Scalar native-position graph arc-coordinate diffusion, coincident UV-seam copies sharing graph node, quadratic B-spline partition over three adjacent axial bones; needle facets have coherent weights. Native geometry/UV/NORMAL/index/PBR unchanged; motion base amplitude not reduced.

thinFacetCoupling.method: Contract only scalar weight graph of native needle facets; all source positions/normals/UV/index/PBR remain unchanged; coincident seam copies share graph coordinates; any head-touching group stays rigid with protected complete head.

graphRegularization.method: Scalar-only unique native-position graph diffusion; coincident UV seam copies share identical coordinates; upper neck Z>=1.28 pinned; no geometry changes

restMapping.method: Bidirectional nearest independent native rest WORLD positions, no weight or vertex-order selection

bellyMotion.anatomySelection: Independent native-world low abdomen: -.95<Y<.35, Z<.85; no weights used

parentVisualAcceptance.judgment: Complete human head and dark healthy eyes readable in ink; intact posterior skull/ears and continuous scaled neck, no new tear/collar; whole native body and pointed tail clear of cards and controls at desktop/tablet/mobile. Offline exported-GLB belly series confirms two abdominal pulses. Actual Stage numeric continuity/ownership/narration sections all passed.

narration.story: 列位看官，《海内东经》在吴西的雷泽写下一位神：雷泽中有雷神，龙身而人头，鼓其腹。人头与龙身，是经文明确的形貌；鼓其腹，也照原文保留。短短一条没有细说龙躯的长短、鳞纹、角翼或肢爪，也没有列出鼓槌和外置的鼓。眼前的形象，取完整人头，经厚实鳞颈连入一条渐细长躯与尖尾，配苍青体鳞、浅灰腹鳞、暖肤和短黑发。这些比例、色彩，以及无臂无足无角无翼，都是本作的设计选择。静候、游弋与腹段的节律起伏，也属于动画演绎；不能把一种具体动作说成鼓其腹的唯一释义。本条没有写春雷、紫电或后世雷公的鸟翼法器，咱们便依这一篇的人头龙身，观看古经留下的雷泽之神。

limitations: Native151 zero/near-zero facets retained; no topology/manifold repair.
Native exact attribute preservation applies to uncompressed rig only; runtime Meshopt/WebP2048 is lossy. Compressed independent rest max0.2044mm, normal max0.09495degrees, UV component max0.0001363.
120Hz motion extrema are sampled, not analytical proof. Actual Stage edge audit excludes sub5mm compression-noise-dominated edges; independent offline compressed QA provides finer source-edge audit.

Candidate QA used explicit GLB/new audio routes and local readiness override. Formal public QA subsequently passed without routes/override, followed by exact-SHA deployed HTTP/UI verification and parent Read of all five production screenshots.

deployment.status: exact-SHA main/CI/Deploy and actual production verified

standardPublicScreenshots.judgment: Intact complete head, dark eyes and continuous native scaled long body. Three actions and consecutive walk frames show no new root tear, ghost body or grounded limb requirements. Entire silhouette clear of controls.
